'''Kletoo''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]. He delivered a parcel to a man known only as "[[D]]" in a back alley bar in [[Tolea Biqua]]. After the exchange was made, Kletoo was forcefully escorted outside the by two [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] henchmen and killed.
